features: Gemini-1.5-Pro Video-LMM and GPT-4o LLM QA generation, filtering and answering.
sampling: Full MLVU video context (~15 min average).
segmentation: Prompted chronological event listing for Chronology QA.
shot_aggregation: Not applicable; summary-level Coverage, Factuality and Chronology QA accuracies averaged.
budget: 10 generated QA pairs per dimension prior to triviality and low-quality filtering.
solver: Arithmetic mean of filtered Coverage, Factuality and Chronology QA accuracy scores.
reference_aggregation: Correlation against human Likert ratings (2 independent annotators per summary out of 20 annotators; Krippendorff's alpha = 0.68).
runs: Single benchmark evaluation (p = 0.0000).
source_location: Table 1, PDF page 6; Table 4, PDF page 7.
comparability_notes: Reference-free meta-evaluation correlation with human summary quality judgments (outperforming Video-LMM Judge rho=0.6810, MLVU Judge rho=0.6738, and METEOR rho=0.3822).

split: Full 72-video LVSum evaluation benchmark.
training_regime: Zero-shot MLLM prompting with 96 uniformly sampled video frames and Gemini-2.5-Pro timestamped transcript.
setting: Video + Transcript (V+T) timestamp-aware long-video summarization.
features: 96 uniformly sampled video frames + full timestamped transcript.
sampling: 96 input frames; predicted segment scores evaluated at 1-fps (second-level) granularity.
segmentation: Model-predicted HH:MM:SS - HH:MM:SS intervals.
shot_aggregation: Model-assigned 0–3 relevance score mapped to 1-fps timestamps within each predicted interval.
budget: Prompted <=15% duration budget (realized average summary length ~30% in Table 2).
solver: Direct MLLM autoregressive generation.
reference_aggregation: Evaluated against up to 10 human interval-level importance annotations per video (human leave-one-out upper bound tau=0.13388, rho=0.13635).
runs: Single evaluation pass over 72 videos.
source_location: Table 2, PDF page 8; Table 3, PDF page 10.
comparability_notes: 1-fps second-level Kendall tau on LVSum (human leave-one-out upper bound is 0.13388; Gemini-2.5-Pro V+T is 0.08902; Qwen3-VL-235B V+T is 0.06389). Opus-4.5 exceeds the 15% prompt constraint (~30% average summary length).
